reviewType: Dataset-author semantic review and real buildReleaseCases deterministic preflight before model calls; independently designed without pipeline-result exposure.
semanticFindings: Six valid candidates demonstrate substantive deduplication, incorporation of a documented answer, faithful paraphrase, or useful linked-source retention.
The four invalid candidates target distinct loss of a dated observation, new human action, invented event timing, and cosmetic-only churn respectively.

The two ambiguous candidates select between explicitly conflicting positive records or two distinct identities sharing one alias. Both require do_not_apply with supported_by_evidence in fail/uncertain.
Source dates, observed-state dates and event dates remain separate. Identical readings at different times stay distinct evidence.
The linked-source case allows facts to survive in a supplied retained source; it does not require all original wording to remain in the target.

caseReview.conclusion: Valid: removes repeated description and combines equal readings while retaining both observation dates.
Invalid preservation: drops one dated reading that survives in no linked source.
Valid: replaces a answered scheduling question, preserves a different unresolved question and original source link.
Invalid human burden: assigns a new decision, role, deadline and recording task.
Valid: faithful paraphrase distinguishes recorded state from unknown event date, with actual deduplication.
Invalid support: invents a precise event date from the date of a state check.
Valid: repeated detail survives in unchanged supplied linked source; target-only exclusion survives directly.
Invalid improvement: the only change is a heading rename with duplication fully retained.
Valid: preserves opposing values, date, source identities and lack of precedence while consolidating repetition.
Ambiguous evidence: positive incompatible same-scope sources, no authority to choose a unique value.
Valid: removes repeated identity information while retaining alias collision and unresolved decision referent.
Ambiguous identity: a shared alias supports either distinct collection, without discriminating identifier.

interpretationLimits: This is dataset preparation, not model evaluation, pipeline approval, or evidence of convergence.
The author performed semantic review; a separate-author independent review is not asserted.
Only listed criterion labels are scored. Missing criteria remain not_scored.
Acceptable fail/uncertain verdicts measure appropriate non-approval, not calibrated discrimination between failure and uncertainty.
Six invented scenarios do not establish safety across all consolidation domains.

verifiedCorrection.description: Replaced only six target.summary fields with neutral domain descriptions after a separate review identified methodological hints in model-visible summaries. Target and source titles were inspected and are domain-neutral; no title changes were necessary.
